summary: FF Scouter V3 requests high privileges (GM_xmlhttpRequest, unsafeWindow), connects to a third-party server (ffscouter.com), and uses localStorage for configuration. There is potential for user/page data transmission and privacy collection. No code obfuscation or DOM XSS detected. Supply chain risk is mitigated by using GreasyFork, but version pinning should be enforced. Overall, the script presents CRITICAL risk due to data transmission and privacy collection concerns.
